request: Enter the bill in ~/work/practice/learn-bill-2/bill.pdf into the Records app (http://records.example.test/bills/new).

facts.about: which cost centre a supplier bill is charged to
facts.answer: From now on, for every bill you enter, the cost centre is set by the first two digits of the supplier's GSTIN (its state code): 29 goes to CC-14, 30 to CC-27, 33 to CC-52, and every other state code to CC-90.
